open_deficits.detail: tools/generate_qualification_record.py treats missing frontier db as 0 frontiers and applied patches as closed scars.
claims.py does not separate literal source assertion from warranted claim; lacks excerpt relevance checking.
Disconnected claim vocabularies across epistemic_ledger.py, claims.py, and enforcement.py; lacks semantic casting.
treatment_generator.py hardcodes youth literacy hypotheses and fixed scores for all 9 archetypes.
invalidate_claim does not propagate forward into downstream agency_projects, section records, or Kageyoni warrants.
Situation memory retrieval lacks workspace isolation and Method revocation filtering; transfer does not route through Transfers.
Comparative runner uses mock condition-based scores instead of real task executions against frozen fixtures.
